description: Source code for the TransactionCoordinatorGrain class, which implements various transaction coordination methods for test grains in Orleans framework.

classes.name: TransactionCoordinatorGrain
classes.description: A stateless worker grain implementing methods to coordinate multiple transaction test grains, including setting values, adding, doubling, and handling exceptions within transactions.

methods.name: MultiGrainSet
methods.description: Sets a new value across multiple grains concurrently.

methods.name: MultiGrainAdd
methods.description: Adds a specified number to multiple grains concurrently.

methods.name: MultiGrainDouble
methods.description: Doubles the value of multiple grains by retrieving and adding their current value.

methods.name: OrphanCallTransaction
methods.description: Initiates an add operation on a grain without awaiting its completion.

methods.name: AddAndThrow
methods.description: Adds a number to a grain and then throws an exception to abort the transaction.

methods.name: MultiGrainAddAndThrow
methods.description: Adds a number to a list of grains, then calls add and throw on another list, testing transaction abort behaviors.

methods.name: MultiGrainSetBit
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in multiple transactional bit array grains.

methods.name: MultiGrainAdd
methods.description: Performs an add operation on multiple grains and commits via a committer.

methods.name: UpdateViolated
methods.description: Performs an add on a grain, potentially to violate transaction constraints.

methods.name: Double
methods.description: Helper method that retrieves values from a grain and adds the first value to itself.

methods.name: MultiGrainDoubleByRWRW
methods.description: Performs a sequence of get and add operations on grains, in read-write, read-write order.

methods.name: MultiGrainDoubleByWRWR
methods.description: Performs a sequence of add and get operations on grains, in write-read, write-read order.
